items.title: 3 Biotech Stocks With Revenue Up To 11%
items.summary: AI related risks just jumped to the top of the Federal Reserve’s financial stability worries, with a surge in complex debt tied to AI infrastructure. That kind of boom and scrutiny can push investors to look at other cutting edge areas. Carefully chosen biotech stocks with solid balance sheets can offer a different source of potential high upside. This article walks through three such biotech opportunities from our US screener. The three biotech stocks covered below are only a small sample...

items.summary: Nvidia’s market cap tumbled $639.1 billion this week, its worst weekly decline ever. The debate now is whether or not investors want to take advantage of the fall.

items.title: Did Bipolar Drug Win Just Shift JNJ's Investment Narrative?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson reported that its second pivotal Phase 3 trial of Caplyta in bipolar I mania met primary and key secondary endpoints, with clinically meaningful improvements in manic symptoms versus placebo, supporting a planned U.S. regulatory filing. The readout strengthens Johnson & Johnson's neuroscience pipeline at a time when the group is also preparing fresh blood cancer data. Together, these developments highlight how late-stage assets may influence future product mix and capital...
